evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion of what the test does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification language or performed settling to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated as a settled requirement — 'must not' / 'must produce' are commitment markers that perform the settling; the speaker expects compliance, not debate.

mints.name: OperationalMustRule
mints.title: must not / must produce — non-negotiable operational constraints
mints.frame: Is the constraint here performed as a settled rule the speaker expects others to follow, rather than as a position still being argued for?
